fields.summary_ko.0: Goldman Sachs cut Samsung Electronics' price target by 30% from KRW 500,000 to KRW 350,000, and SK Hynix by 43% from KRW 3.5 million to KRW 2 million, reflecting anticipated 2028 memory price declines.
fields.summary_ko.1: DRAM supply deficit ratio expected to narrow from 5.1% in 2027 to 1.2% in 2028, with generic DRAM and NAND prices each anticipated to fall approximately 20%, while HBM market growth alone insufficient to offset earnings deterioration.
